# Asymmetric

`layout/asymmetric` &middot; section-level &middot; category: layout

## Purpose

An editorial two-column layout: a large main column and a smaller, offset side column.

## Required fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `main` | components (content-level) |  |
| `aside` | components (content-level) |  |

## Optional fields

None.

## Variants

Same data and structure, different styling. Pick one with `{ variant: 'name' }`.

- **default**: Large main column on the left, smaller offset column on the right.
- **aside-left**: Smaller offset column on the left, large main column on the right. Sets `asidePosition: left`.

## Settings

Every setting has a default. Values may be token references (`@colors.accent`, `@theme.card.radius`). Pass overrides with `{ settings: { ... } }`.

| Setting | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `hideOnMobile` | boolean | `false` |
| `hideOnDesktop` | boolean | `false` |
| `background` | color | `"@colors.surface"` |
| `padding` | spacing | `"@theme.section.paddingY @theme.section.paddingX @theme.section.paddingY @theme.section.paddingX"` |
| `split` | text | `"65/35"` |
| `asidePosition` | one of `right`, `left` | `"right"` |
| `offset` | length | `"@spacing.2xl"` |
| `columnPadding` | spacing | `"0 @spacing.sm"` |

## Responsive behavior

- `hideOnMobile`: hides it below 480px. Outlook desktop and Gmail on non-Google accounts ignore media queries and still show it.
- `hideOnDesktop`: shows it only on phones. Clients that ignore media queries keep it hidden.

## Compatibility

| Outlook desktop | Gmail apps | Dark mode |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Renders as a table row. The offset is a spacer, so it works. | Stacking works. Gmail on non-Google accounts shows the desktop layout on phones. | Swaps via dm-* classes when on the brand surface or background color. |



## Example usage

This is a section-level component: use it directly in an email body or a recipe.

In an email (`.mjml`):

```
[[ c('layout/asymmetric', {
  "main": [
    {
      "component": "content/image",
      "data": {
        "image": {
          "src": "https://placehold.co/380x460/png?text=Lookbook",
          "alt": "A model wearing a linen shirt on a terrace at golden hour"
        }
      }
    }
  ],
  "aside": [
    {
      "component": "content/heading",
      "data": {
        "text": "The Terrace Edit"
      },
      "settings": {
        "level": "h3"
      }
    },
    {
      "component": "content/text",
      "data": {
        "text": "Loose linens and soft neutrals, styled for long lunches in the sun."
      }
    },
    {
      "component": "content/button",
      "data": {
        "label": "Shop the edit",
        "href": "https://example.com/collections/terrace"
      }
    }
  ]
}) ]]
```
